_favour: The other side of hostility (#290): a clan that likes you enough does something for you. friendly: its own never hunt you on the floor. trusted: the first of its own you meet on a floor draws you its map. devoted: its own take mercy at least `mercy` of the time, and the first strike that lands on one of them breaks its faith: its standing falls back to `broken`. `at` is the standing each starts at; the first is `friendly_at`. Set high on purpose (a sparing is 14, a request done 10, a lord heard out 24): several clans can be devoted in one run, but each takes a run's worth of kindness to it.
